milestones.text: went back for a second session even though the first one was humbling
milestones.post: Went back. That has to count for something.

milestones.text: learned the basic terms everyone at {hobby} kept using
milestones.post: I now understand about half the words. Progress.

milestones.text: made it through a whole beginners' session without stopping for a rest
milestones.post: Whole session, no sitting down. Tiny victory.

milestones.text: asked an old hand for one tip and got a genuinely useful one
milestones.post: One good tip from someone who knows. Already better.

milestones.text: finished their first week of {hobby} tired in the best way
milestones.post: Week one done. Sleeping like a stone tonight.

milestones.text: set aside a fixed time every week for {hobby}
milestones.post: It's a standing appointment now. No wriggling out.

milestones.text: discovered the warm-up alone was a proper workout
milestones.post: Nobody warned me the warm-up was the hard part.

milestones.text: went three weeks without missing a single session
milestones.post: Three weeks straight. Who even am I?

milestones.text: stopped needing to be corrected every few minutes
milestones.post: Went a whole session without a single correction.

milestones.text: did easily what had felt impossible in their first week
milestones.post: Remember when this was impossible? Me neither, nearly.

milestones.text: got a nod of approval from the most serious regular
milestones.post: The serious one nodded at me. I'll take it.

milestones.text: learned to pace a session instead of going flat out and fading
milestones.post: Paced myself for once. Finished strong.

milestones.text: bought their own proper kit instead of borrowing
milestones.post: My own kit at last. No more borrowed odds and ends.

milestones.text: talked about {hobby} through an entire supper without noticing
milestones.post: Apparently I talked about it all through supper. Oops.

milestones.text: helped a nervous newcomer through a first session
milestones.post: Showed a beginner the ropes today. Felt good.

milestones.text: was invited to train with the keen early group
milestones.post: Got asked to join the early lot. Alarm set.

milestones.text: felt their technique click into place on an ordinary weekday
milestones.post: Something clicked today. No idea what, but it did.

milestones.text: trained on a cold, grey morning when staying in bed was the easy choice
milestones.post: Cold, grey, early. Went anyway. Smug now.

milestones.text: had a session where absolutely everything worked
milestones.post: One of those days where it all just works.

milestones.text: was asked to show the group how a tricky part is done
milestones.post: Demonstrated for the group. Hands only slightly shaky.

milestones.text: kept pace with people who had been at {hobby} for years
milestones.post: Kept up with the veterans today. Quietly thrilled.

milestones.text: entered their first real competition and did not come last
milestones.post: First competition. Not last. Calling it a triumph.

milestones.text: held their own in a friendly match against a rival club
milestones.post: Rival club, friendly match, held my own.

milestones.text: was asked to help run the beginners' sessions for a season
milestones.post: I'm helping teach the beginners now. Strange and lovely.

milestones.text: drew up a training plan for the whole season and actually stuck to it
milestones.post: Made a plan. Followed the plan. Shocking.

milestones.text: won a small local prize and kept the ribbon on the mantelpiece
milestones.post: Small prize, big grin. The ribbon stays on display.

milestones.text: was named the most improved member of the club
milestones.post: Most improved. I'll pretend I'm not proud.

milestones.text: entered a competition well above their level and lost, gloriously
milestones.post: Outclassed in every way. Had the best day.

milestones.text: won first place at a regional competition
milestones.post: First place. Still can't quite believe it.

milestones.text: was invited onto the club's top team
milestones.post: Top team. Years of early mornings, worth every one.

milestones.text: coached a beginner all the way to a first competition
milestones.post: My first student competed today. Prouder than of any win.

milestones.text: set a club record
milestones.post: Club record. My name on the board.

milestones.text: was asked to judge a junior competition
milestones.post: Judging the juniors. When did I become the old hand?

milestones.text: marked five years of {hobby} with their best season yet
milestones.post: Five years in and this was the best season so far.

milestones.text: had their name engraved on the club trophy
milestones.post: My name, engraved. On the actual trophy.

milestones.text: reached the top of their first wall at the climbing gym
milestones.post: Top of the wall! Arms like cooked noodles.

milestones.text: learned to tie a figure-eight knot without checking the diagram
milestones.post: Figure-eight from memory. Trust me with ropes now.

milestones.text: passed their belay check at the climbing gym
milestones.post: Officially allowed to hold someone's rope. Responsibility.

milestones.text: sent their first V3 boulder problem
milestones.post: V3 sent. Fingers gone, worth it.

milestones.text: led their first route on real rock
milestones.post: First lead outside. Heart still racing.

milestones.text: climbed their first 6c route outdoors
milestones.post: 6c outside. A year ago I couldn't do the warm-up wall.

milestones.text: sent the project they had been falling off all summer
milestones.post: All summer on this one. Finally topped it.

milestones.text: ran a whole kilometre without stopping to walk
milestones.post: One full kilometre, no walking. Lungs filing complaints.

milestones.text: bought their first pair of proper running shoes after a fitting
milestones.post: Real running shoes. They make me look serious.

milestones.text: finished their first 5k parkrun
milestones.post: First parkrun done. Everyone clapped. I nearly cried.

milestones.text: logged a hundred kilometres on their running app
milestones.post: 100 km on the app. Didn't know my legs had it in them.

milestones.text: ran 10k in under an hour
milestones.post: Sub-hour 10k. Ran it twice in my head before believing it.

milestones.text: finished their first half marathon
milestones.post: Half marathon done. Walking down stairs is a project.

milestones.text: ran a full marathon and crossed the line smiling
milestones.post: 26.2 miles. Smiling the whole last one.

milestones.text: swam a whole length of the baths without grabbing the side
milestones.post: A whole length. The side of the pool and I are on a break.

milestones.text: learned to breathe properly between strokes
milestones.post: Breathing and swimming at the same time. Revolutionary.

milestones.text: swam twenty lengths in one go
milestones.post: Twenty lengths without stopping. Pruney but proud.

milestones.text: learned to dive in cleanly from the edge
milestones.post: Clean dive, no belly flop. Witnesses confirm.

milestones.text: swam a mile in open water
milestones.post: A mile in the open water. Cold, glorious, done.

milestones.text: won the club's annual long-distance swim
milestones.post: Won the long swim. Still tasting lake water.

milestones.text: swam fifty lengths on a quiet early morning at the leisure centre
milestones.post: Fifty lengths before work. The pool was all mine.

milestones.text: rode the length of the street without a single wobble
milestones.post: Down the whole street, no wobbles. Watch out, world.

milestones.text: cycled to the next town and back in one afternoon
milestones.post: Next town and back. Legs have opinions.

milestones.text: climbed the big hill out of town without getting off to push
milestones.post: The big hill, no pushing. I may never stop talking about it.

milestones.text: mended a puncture by the roadside all by themselves
milestones.post: Fixed my own puncture by the road. Hands filthy, heart full.

milestones.text: rode a hundred miles in a single day
milestones.post: A hundred miles in a day. Saddle and I need a rest.

milestones.text: won the club's hill-climb race
milestones.post: Won the hill climb. Fastest up, slowest walk after.

milestones.text: held downward dog for a whole minute without collapsing
milestones.post: A whole minute of downward dog. Arms trembling, spirit high.

milestones.text: made it through their first full class at the yoga studio
milestones.post: First full class. Lay very still at the end, very gladly.

milestones.text: touched their toes for the first time in years
milestones.post: Touched my toes. Hello, old friends.

milestones.text: held a steady crow pose for five breaths
milestones.post: Crow pose, five breaths, no face-plant.

milestones.text: kicked up into a headstand away from the wall
milestones.post: Headstand, no wall. Upside-down and delighted.

milestones.text: finished a 30-day yoga challenge without skipping a day
milestones.post: Thirty days, thirty mats rolled out. Done.

milestones.text: finished a yoga teacher training course
milestones.post: Qualified to teach yoga. Still can't believe that.

milestones.text: kept a rally going for ten shots
milestones.post: Ten shots in a rally. That's a conversation, basically.

milestones.text: served three in a row that actually landed in
milestones.post: Three serves in a row, all in. Mark the date.

milestones.text: learned to hit a backhand that went where they meant it to
milestones.post: My backhand now goes roughly where I aim it.

milestones.text: won their first set against a club member
milestones.post: Won a set! My opponent was very gracious about it.

milestones.text: reached the semi-finals of the club tournament
milestones.post: Semi-finals. My knees and I are both surprised.

milestones.text: won the club's summer singles tournament
milestones.post: Summer singles champion. Say that slowly.

milestones.text: learned the basic stance and kept their guard up for a whole round
milestones.post: Guard up, whole round. Arms are lead now.

milestones.text: skipped rope for three minutes without tripping once
milestones.post: Three minutes of skipping, no tangles. A personal miracle.

milestones.text: threw a clean one-two combination on the heavy bag
milestones.post: Jab, cross, and the bag actually swung. Satisfying.

milestones.text: went three full rounds of light sparring and kept their footwork tidy
milestones.post: Three rounds of sparring. Feet stayed where they should.

milestones.text: fought their first amateur bout and went the distance
milestones.post: First bout. Went every round. Shaking, smiling.

milestones.text: won their first amateur bout on points
milestones.post: Won on points. Gloves hung up proudly tonight.

milestones.text: learned to tie their belt the proper way
milestones.post: Tied my belt right on the first try. Small things.

milestones.text: survived their first jiu-jitsu class and stayed for the rolling
milestones.post: First jiu-jitsu class. Stayed to roll. Got folded, happily.

milestones.text: earned the first stripe on their white belt
milestones.post: One stripe on the white belt. It's a start.

milestones.text: finally escaped from mount against a senior student
milestones.post: Escaped mount on a purple belt. Doing a tiny dance.

milestones.text: landed their first clean sweep during rolling
milestones.post: Pulled off a clean sweep. Felt like a magic trick.

milestones.text: was promoted to blue belt
milestones.post: Blue belt. Took a while. Worth every class.

milestones.text: won gold in their division at a local jiu-jitsu open
milestones.post: Gold medal at the local open. Still grinning.

milestones.text: learned the en garde stance and a basic lunge
milestones.post: En garde, lunge, recover. Thighs on fire.

milestones.text: practised the footwork until it stopped feeling like a strange dance
milestones.post: The footwork is almost natural now. Almost.

milestones.text: scored their first clean touch in a practice bout
milestones.post: First clean touch. Did a very undignified cheer.

milestones.text: won a practice bout against a senior student
milestones.post: Beat a senior student in practice. They took it well.

milestones.text: parried the fencing master's attack and answered with a neat riposte
milestones.post: Parried the master. Once. That's going on my headstone.

milestones.text: fought in their first fencing tournament and won two bouts
milestones.post: First tournament, two bouts won. Not bad at all.

milestones.text: won the fencing school's annual tournament
milestones.post: Champion of the school. The master shook my hand.

milestones.text: hit the target at twenty paces for the first time
milestones.post: Hit the target! Not the middle, but the target.

milestones.text: learned to string their bow without help
milestones.post: Strung my own bow. The bow and I have an understanding.

milestones.text: put three arrows in a row in the inner ring
milestones.post: Three in the inner ring. Grouping, they call it.

milestones.text: fletched their own arrows and shot them true
milestones.post: My own arrows, my own feathers, and they fly straight.

milestones.text: shot a full round without a single miss
milestones.post: A full round, nothing in the grass. Proud archer.

milestones.text: won a ribbon at the local archery contest
milestones.post: Ribbon at the archery contest. Arms tired, heart full.

milestones.text: won the archery contest outright
milestones.post: Won the whole contest. The final arrow was dead centre.

milestones.text: learned to saddle and bridle a horse on their own
milestones.post: Tacked up on my own. The horse was very patient.

milestones.text: sat a trot without bouncing out of the saddle
milestones.post: Sat the trot. My spine sends its thanks.

milestones.text: rode their first canter around the paddock
milestones.post: First canter. Felt like flying, only bumpier.

milestones.text: took the horse over their first small jump
milestones.post: Over a little jump, both of us together. Wonderful.

milestones.text: rode out alone across country for a whole day
milestones.post: A whole day in the saddle, just me and the horse.

milestones.text: won a rosette at the county show
milestones.post: A rosette at the county show. The horse deserves it more.

milestones.text: climbed into the boat without tipping it
milestones.post: Got in the boat, boat stayed upright. Good start.

milestones.text: rowed the whole river stretch without catching a crab
milestones.post: Whole stretch, no crabs caught. Clean strokes all the way.

milestones.text: earned a seat in the club's eight
milestones.post: Got a seat in the eight. Early mornings forever now.

milestones.text: raced in their first regatta
milestones.post: First regatta. Rowed my heart out on the river.

milestones.text: won their race at the summer regatta
milestones.post: Won at the regatta. The whole crew was shouting.

milestones.text: rowed at dawn with the river mist still lying on the water
milestones.post: Dawn row, mist on the river. Worth the alarm.

milestones.text: made it once round the rink without holding the rail
milestones.post: Once round, no rail. Wobbly, but upright.

milestones.text: learned to stop properly instead of aiming for the wall
milestones.post: I can stop now. The wall is relieved.

milestones.text: skated backwards across the whole rink
milestones.post: Backwards across the ice. Looked over my shoulder a lot.

milestones.text: landed a clean waltz jump
milestones.post: Waltz jump, clean landing. Spun round grinning.

milestones.text: skated a solo programme at the club's winter show
milestones.post: My own solo at the winter show. Ice felt like home.

milestones.text: glided a long smooth curve on one foot
milestones.post: One foot, one long curve. Felt like gliding in a dream.

milestones.text: learned to deadlift with proper form
milestones.post: Proper deadlift form. The coach said 'good' once.

milestones.text: worked up the courage to use the free-weights area at the gym
milestones.post: Ventured into the free weights. Nobody laughed.

milestones.text: squatted their own body weight
milestones.post: Squatted my own body weight. Legs like jelly.

milestones.text: deadlifted a hundred kilos
milestones.post: 100 kg off the floor. Put the bar down very carefully.

milestones.text: entered their first powerlifting meet
milestones.post: First meet. Three good lifts. Hands still chalky.

milestones.text: won their weight class at a local meet
milestones.post: First in my class. Lifting, eating, sleeping, repeat.

milestones.text: stood up on the board for the first time, for about two seconds
milestones.post: Stood up! For two whole seconds! Then the sea won.

milestones.text: caught their first unbroken green wave
milestones.post: First green wave. Couldn't stop laughing.

milestones.text: paddled out past the break on their own
milestones.post: Made it out past the break alone. Big moment.

milestones.text: surfed a proper overhead wave
milestones.post: Overhead wave, rode it all the way. Shaking.

milestones.text: placed in the local surf contest
milestones.post: Placed at the surf contest. Salt in my hair for days.

milestones.text: caught a dawn session before work and still made it on time
milestones.post: Surfed before work. Best commute ever.

milestones.text: rolled across the whole car park without stepping off
milestones.post: Whole car park, no stepping off. Cautiously proud.

milestones.text: landed their first ollie
milestones.post: Ollie landed. Just an inch off the ground, but still.

milestones.text: finally landed a clean kickflip
milestones.post: Kickflip. Clean. After about four hundred tries.

milestones.text: dropped in on the big bowl at the skatepark
milestones.post: Dropped in on the big bowl. Didn't think about it, just went.

milestones.text: put together a full run at the skatepark contest
milestones.post: Full run at the contest, no bails. The kids cheered.

milestones.text: learned to grind along a curb at the skatepark
milestones.post: Grinding curbs now. The curb did not ask for this.

milestones.text: made it through a full practice without stopping
milestones.post: Full practice. Still standing.

milestones.text: learned the basic form properly
milestones.post: Form first. Got it.

milestones.text: stopped feeling sore the day after
milestones.post: No more aching mornings.

milestones.text: kept up with the group for the first time
milestones.post: Kept up today!

milestones.text: went three times in one week
milestones.post: Three times this week.

milestones.text: learned to breathe properly while working hard
milestones.post: Breathing right changes everything.

milestones.text: was told their form had improved
milestones.post: Form's improving, apparently.

milestones.text: got up early to practise and liked it
milestones.post: Early start. Liked it?!

milestones.text: learned to warm up properly
milestones.post: Warm-up, done right.

milestones.text: learned to rest properly between sessions
milestones.post: Rest is training too.

milestones.text: beat their own best effort
milestones.post: New best.

milestones.text: trained through bad weather without missing a session
milestones.post: Rain or not, I went.

milestones.text: felt strong for the first time
milestones.post: Felt strong today.

milestones.text: made a skill that once felt impossible look easy
milestones.post: Impossible last month. Easy today.

milestones.text: kept going a whole season without a break
milestones.post: A whole season. No breaks.

milestones.text: learned to read an opponent's next move
milestones.post: Saw the move before it came.

milestones.text: was paired with someone better and held up
milestones.post: Held up against someone better.

milestones.text: found a steady rhythm in training
milestones.post: Found my rhythm.

milestones.text: recovered from a bad day and came back stronger
milestones.post: Bad day, better comeback.

milestones.text: won a friendly contest
milestones.post: Won a friendly one!

milestones.text: was picked for the side
milestones.post: Picked!

milestones.text: trained a beginner through the basics
milestones.post: Teaching the basics.

milestones.text: took part in the town games
milestones.post: Town games, done.

milestones.text: finished in the top three of a local contest
milestones.post: Top three!

milestones.text: learned an advanced technique after months of trying
milestones.post: Months of trying. Got it.

milestones.text: trained twice a day for a whole week
milestones.post: Twice a day all week.

milestones.text: was trusted to lead the practice for a day
milestones.post: Led practice today.

milestones.text: felt the work pay off in a real contest
milestones.post: It paid off.

milestones.text: kept steady nerves through a whole contest
milestones.post: Steady all the way.

milestones.text: won a contest outright
milestones.post: Won it outright.

milestones.text: beat a long-time rival
milestones.post: Finally beat the rival.

milestones.text: represented the town at a contest further afield
milestones.post: Representing the town!

milestones.text: was given a place on the best side in town
milestones.post: On the best side in town.

milestones.text: set a mark that still stands in town
milestones.post: My mark stands.

milestones.text: was asked to help train the younger ones
milestones.post: Training the young ones.

milestones.text: came back from behind in a contest to win
milestones.post: From behind to the win.

milestones.text: earned real respect from the old hands
milestones.post: Respect from the old hands.

milestones.text: won a prize at the summer fair
milestones.post: Summer fair prize!

milestones.text: won the biggest contest of the year
milestones.post: Biggest win of the year.

milestones.text: was called the best in the region
milestones.post: Best in the region? Me?

milestones.text: trained a pupil who went on to win
milestones.post: My student won!

milestones.text: went a whole year unbeaten
milestones.post: Unbeaten all year.

milestones.text: was invited to show the sport before honoured guests
milestones.post: Showing off for honoured guests.

milestones.text: won a contest still talked about
milestones.post: Still talked about.

milestones.text: became the one the young ones want to be like
milestones.post: The young ones look up to me now.

milestones.text: won the champion's prize at the great fair
milestones.post: Champion at the great fair.

milestones.text: had a contest named in their honour
milestones.post: A contest named for me.

milestones.text: got a first clean hit
milestones.post: Clean hit!

milestones.text: caught a fly ball without flinching
milestones.post: Caught it!

milestones.text: hit a double with runners on base
milestones.post: Double! Runs in!

milestones.text: hit a home run
milestones.post: HOME RUN.

milestones.text: was voted the team's most valuable player
milestones.post: MVP. Me.

milestones.text: hit a drive straight down the fairway
milestones.post: Straight down the middle.

milestones.text: finished nine holes without losing a ball
milestones.post: Nine holes, zero lost balls.

milestones.text: made par on a hard hole
milestones.post: Par on the hard one.

milestones.text: beat a scoring goal set a year ago
milestones.post: Goal broken.

milestones.text: hit a hole in one
milestones.post: HOLE IN ONE.

milestones.text: made a first clean pass in a real game
milestones.post: Clean pass!

milestones.text: scored a first goal
milestones.post: GOAL.

milestones.text: played a whole game without being subbed off
milestones.post: Full game.

milestones.text: scored the winning goal in a league game
milestones.post: Winner!

milestones.text: was named captain of the side
milestones.post: Captain now.

milestones.text: made it down a beginner slope without falling
milestones.post: No falls!

milestones.text: linked turns all the way down a run
milestones.post: Linked turns!

milestones.text: skied a harder run for the first time
milestones.post: Harder run, done.

milestones.text: skied fresh powder at first light
milestones.post: First tracks.

milestones.text: made it down the steepest run on the mountain
milestones.post: The steep one. Done.

sessions.text: Kept it steady and unhurried today.
Worked on one small thing over and over.
Went in sluggish and came out feeling much better.
Spent the first half warming up properly for once.
Had a good chat with a regular between efforts.
Tried something new and mostly got it wrong, cheerfully.
Kept going a little longer than planned.
Stretched out properly afterwards, as they always mean to.
Did the basics carefully, the way the teacher keeps saying.
Took it easy and simply enjoyed it.
Pushed a little harder near the end.
Noticed a small improvement nobody else would spot.
Practised the part they always find hardest.
Felt clumsy at first, then found a rhythm.
Shared a laugh with the others at the end.
Went through the whole routine twice.
